question: The All India Forward Bloc was founded by ______ in 1939 after resigning from the Congress Presidentship.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Subhash Chandra Bose.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
• **The correct answer is option 4, Subhash Chandra Bose, who founded the All India Forward Bloc in 1939 after resigning from the Congress Presidentship.**

 
 
• Subhash Chandra Bose was a prominent leader of the Indian independence movement and a strong advocate of complete independence from British rule.
 
 
 
• ** Bal Gangadhar Tilak **was a nationalist leader and social reformer who played a key role in the** Indian independence movement, but he died in 1920 before the formation of the All India Forward Bloc.**
 
• ** Mahatma Gandhi **was the leader of the Indian independence movement and the Congress party, but** he did not resign from the Congress Presidentship to form the All India Forward Bloc.**
 
• **Jawaharlal Nehru **was a prominent leader of the Indian independence movement and the** first Prime Minister of independent India, but he did not resign from the Congress Presidentship to form the All India Forward Bloc.**
